info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Cancellation policies API

items.docs:
> ### Restricted!
> This operation is currently in beta-test and as such it is subject to change.
Returns all cancellation policies, filtered by services, rate groups and other filters. 
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Gets cancellation policies for enterprise grouped by reservation for granular cancellation policies flow. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Gets cancellation policies for enterprise grouped by rate for granular cancellation policies flow. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
